A Techmeme excerpt attributes to Thariq Shihipar an announcement that he joined OpenAI after leaving Anthropic in October, explaining the move in terms of where he feels he can contribute most. It also conveys respect for his former colleagues and a role for both companies.

The linked profile did not expose the specific announcement text in the source cache, so the exact role, start date and responsibilities are not verified beyond the feed account. The move was also noted in [the Latent Space episode description](../summaries/f0530255a4a0.md), but neither source demonstrates a particular unreleased product strategy or hostile split.
highlights: Feed attributes the announcement to Shihipar
Departure from Anthropic is dated to October
Exact position and duties are not established
Profile page is not the specific source post
Episode description separately notes the move
No inference about a secret roadmap is warranted
